usedFor: Sellers use SellerMate.AI to run ad campaigns with “Create Campaign”, “Update Campaign” and “Add Negative Keywords”.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Updated” in WooCommerce, then “Create Campaign” in SellerMate.AI
bestTemplate.why: A changed order can adjust a campaign, so ads follow what sells.

watchOut: “Update Campaign” can change the daily budget, so keep budget changes behind approval.
